body:
This PR implements the Hello World program in Common Lisp as requested in issue #1.

## Changes
- Added  with a simple Hello World program
- Included proper comments and run instructions
- Created GitHub Actions workflow in 
- The workflow installs SBCL, runs the program, and verifies the output

## Testing
- Program tested locally with SBCL
- CI workflow will run on every push and PR to ensure correctness

Closes #1
